aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:873.title: Marketing Manager - Pacific Northwest - Portland
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:873.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! A Brief Overview Portland’s newest venue is a 68,000-square-foot facility designed to support dynamic, large-scale live events. It offers flexible seating for 2,000 to 4,250 attendees and features a movable stage that enables multiple event configurations, making it well suited for the city’s diverse live music scene. Located at the former Nordstrom site on NE Multnomah Street, the venue sits within the Lloyd District and the Lloyd Entertainment District—an area known for its creative energy and accessibility. It is less than one mile from the Moda Center and the Oregon Convention Center, expanding the footprint of the state’s most vibrant entertainment district. The venue also provides convenient access to light rail and streetcar lines, as well as a north–south bike and pedestrian bridge. Extensive surface and adjacent parking is available at nearby Lloyd Mall structures, reflecting Portland’s emphasis on connectivity, community, and vibrant urban experiences. The Marketing Manager is responsible for all marketing assets, advertising, and promotion strategy for shows within the region. This position will work in conjunction with artist managers, agents and marketing teams to develop effective integrated marketing plans that reach the correct demographic and target audiences for each show to drive ticket sales. The Marketing Manager will be in constant communication with talent buyers, local, and central leadership in order to oversee execution of best practices across email, social, traditional media buying, Customer Relationship Management, reporting, etc. This position will also be responsible for maintaining and tracking budgets to make sure funds are allocated correctly. This role will also be responsible for overseeing social media accounts, brand engagement, and fan engagement to ensure all content is relevant and engaging. Essential Functions: Responsible for development and execution of integrated marketing and promotional plans for shows within assigned region. Collaborate with central marketing leadership and local team to plan the marketing spend and roll out long-term marketing initiatives. Generate and adhere to marketing budget. Book and account for all advertising and media ensuring funds are allocated to correct partners. Oversee advertising settlements for each show. Build digital advertising plans and monitor daily to optimize campaigns for best performance to drive ticket sales. Develop ad copy. Implement ad schedules to appeal to a specific demographic and target customer. Oversee and evaluate show performance market-by-market, making adjustments to meet marketing strategy in changing market or competitive conditions. Compile relevant demographic data to marketing teams and talent buyers in order to drive the most profitable ticket sales and successful marketing campaigns. cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:0ba.description: Welcome to the Table. At Sur La Table, community, culinary joy, and celebration are at the heart of who we are. From monthly spotlights to the Golden Whisk awards and cooking class perks, our culture blends recognition with hands-on experiences. New team members are welcomed with care and inspired by wellness events, inclusive stories, and a personal touch that makes you feel right at home. responsibilities: Recruiting & Staffing
Manage full-cycle recruiting for BDC roles — posting, screening, offers, and Day 1 clearance — with volume increasing during peak and seasonal windows.
Manage temp staffing operations, including agency relationships, onboarding and offboarding, and hours submission.
Onboarding & New Hire Experience

Own the new hire experience end to end — facilitate orientation, ensure every system and document is ready before Day 1, and run structured 15/45/90-day check-ins that surface trends and share findings with key leaders.
Workforce Administration

Produce and distribute regular HR reports — headcount, rosters, terminations, OSHA, perfect attendance, labor — and communicate what the numbers mean clearly.
Run recognition programs, coordinate engagement initiatives, execute BDC events, and conduct exit interviews that translate findings into actionable patterns.

Solid understanding of federal and state employment law
Ability to translate AI capabilities into business outcomes — identifying high-leverage opportunities where AI can improve decision quality, organizational speed, and workforce effectiveness

Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4395edfb-c5c0-.title: Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4395edfb-c5c0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video based in France. As a Senior Applied Research Engineer, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation. You will work at the intersection of generative AI research, large-scale distributed systems, and production engineering. Your work will focus on developing realistic, controllable, and expressive video generation models that can operate reliably at scale. You will own research and engineering projects end to end, translating hypotheses and experiments into measurable product impact. The role combines advanced modeling, distributed training, evaluation, inference optimization, and rigorous experimentation. You will operate in a highly technical, high-ownership environment where research is expected to move quickly toward real-world deployment. Your contributions will directly influence AI-powered video products used by businesses around the world. Develop and scale latent video diffusion models designed for human-centric video generation. Design advanced conditioning mechanisms that improve control over elements such as pose, emotion, scripts, and camera movement while maintaining high visual fidelity. Lead end-to-end applied research and engineering projects, from developing hypotheses and running experiments through to production implementation and measurable impact. Develop and optimize distributed training strategies using technologies such as DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, and sequence parallelism. Improve training stability and efficiency across large-scale, multi-GPU and multi-node environments while working within real-world compute constraints. Design robust evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics with structured human evaluation to assess model quality and performance. Optimize model inference for low latency, high resolution, scalability, and cost efficiency in production environments. Run controlled experiments, ablations, and parallel research hypotheses to identify high-value signals and guide modeling decisions. Establish and maintain strong engineering practices around reproducibility, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring, and production reliability. Translate research findings into practical improvements for production-grade generative video systems. Collaborate actively with researchers, engineers, and cross-functional teams while maintaining a high degree of individual ownership. Move quickly between promising research directions, identifying low-signal approaches early and prioritizing work based on measurable outcomes. Requirements Strong professional experience training deep learning models at scale, ideally in a research or production environment. Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on expertise with PyTorch. Practical experience working with diffusion models, with image-generation experience required and video-generation experience strongly preferred. Proven experience with large-scale multi-GPU and multi-node model training. Strong understanding of distributed training frameworks and techniques such as DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, or comparable technologies. Ability to design controlled experiments, analyze noisy or ambiguous results, and make scientifically grounded modeling decisions. Experience with video diffusion models is an advantage. Experience with avatar generation, synthetic humans, or other human-centric generative AI applications is a plus. Familiarity with world models, interactive models, GANs, or VAEs is desirable. Experience optimizing inference systems for production deployment is an advantage. Strong understanding of CUDA and experience working within modern machine learning infrastructure. Ability to work effectively with technologies such as AWS, SLURM, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed training and inference systems. Research-driven

manaycpacom-manaycpa-com:lever:f490ac7e-.description: Manay CPA is hiring on behalf of a global leader in industrial engineering and manufacturing, originally established in the early 1970s. With more than five decades of experience delivering complex, large-scale fabrication projects, the company operates advanced production facilities across Turkey and Asia and serves clients in over 80 countries worldwide. The organization provides end-to-end engineering and manufacturing solutions across industries including energy, oil & gas, nuclear, shipbuilding, and infrastructure. Renowned for its precision engineering, modular fabrication capabilities, and internationally certified manufacturing processes, the company has built a strong global reputation for quality, reliability, and technical excellence. Backed by decades of industry leadership, a highly skilled workforce, and a commitment to continuous innovation, the company continues to support some of the world's most demanding industrial projects while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Structural Professional Engineer (PE) with a strong background in steel connection design to join our team in support of a new project in New York. This role has been created specifically to support this partnership, giving the successful candidate the opportunity to play a key role from the ground up. In this role, you will serve as the PE of record for all steel connection design activities, ensuring that calculations, shop drawings, and supporting documentation meet the highest standards of accuracy and code compliance. You will act as a key technical liaison among the Engineer of Record (EOR), client, general contractor, fabricator, design subcontractor, and detailers, helping to keep the project moving smoothly from design through construction. The ideal candidate has a strong technical foundation in steel connection design, excellent attention to detail, and enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced project environment. We value individuals who communicate effectively, take initiative, and can navigate complex coordination across multiple stakeholders. Experience reviewing Tekla models, resolving RFIs, and supporting fabrication and construction teams with practical solutions will be key to success in this role.

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:a1090777-a58.title: Product Designer, International Growth (Tinder Seoul)
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:a1090777-a58.description: Location: Seoul, South Korea (collaborating with global teams) Legal Entity: Hyperconnect Team: Tinder International Growth Team About the Team Tinder is available in 160+ countries, but the experience is still largely one-size-fits-all — and that's the opportunity. International Growth exists to change it: to build organic growth flywheels through deep localization, in close partnership with Marketing, starting in core APAC cities and turning what works into a repeatable, scalable playbook we can take to new markets. Based in Seoul, we're a small, autonomous, cross-functional pod — Product, Design, Engineering, and Data working side by side, moving fast and shipping real experiments — in close partnership with regional local teams (Japan, India, and more) and the global organizations at our U.S. headquarters. Design sits at the center of the bet: making Tinder feel like it was built for each market, not merely translated for it. About the Role As a Product Designer on International Growth, you'll own end-to-end product design for experiences that reach users across some of the world's most exciting dating markets — from concept and research through launch. You'll design localized experiences that reflect each market's culture and the real needs of local users, help turn successful bets into a reusable localization playbook, and directly shape how millions of people discover, trust, and recommend Tinder. Working shoulder to shoulder with PM, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and regional teams — and grounded in data and user research — you'll craft experiences that feel unmistakably local. And because the pod is small and fast, your work ships, gets measured, and improves quickly. Where you'll work This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week. Our office is located in Seoul.
responsibilities: Own unified, end-to-end design for new features and improvements — from concept to release — across localized experiences in international markets.
Design visual interfaces, wireframes, user flows, interactions, and prototypes.
Design localized product experiences that reflect each market's cultural context and the real needs of local users.
Starting in core APAC cities, design experiences that make users trust, enjoy, and recommend Tinder (improving engagement and reconsideration).
Partner with Marketing and regional local teams to shape localization strategies that build organic growth flywheels, bringing a strong design perspective.
Distill successful localization efforts into repeatable, scalable design patterns and playbooks, and extend them to new markets.
Create and test concepts grounded in user research, data, and diverse insights, and deliver complete, end-to-end solutions.
Maintain design consistency and quality across your own and adjacent teams based on the Tinder design system, flagging quality concerns to the responsible designers and design managers.
Communicate design intent, goals, and rationale clearly through storytelling, in ways accessible to those unfamiliar with the project.
Translate complex ideas into intuitive, high-quality designs, and validate and refine them through rapid experimentation and iteration.
qualifications: 4+ years of professional product design experience (including 2+ years in mobile design).

Fluency across the full 0→1 product design process: discovery, research, concepting, information architecture (IA), prototyping, interaction design, micro-interactions, and design QA with engineering.
Experience designing for iOS, Android (and web), with an understanding of Apple's HIG and Material Design patterns.
Strong visual design fundamentals — typography, layout, and color — with outstanding visual design skills.
Proficiency with Figma, prototyping tools, and design systems.
Experience making decisions grounded in data and user research, and refining designs based on the results.
Ability to collaborate smoothly with partners and senior leaders across functions and cultures, with a self-driven, low-ego attitude and a bias for moving fast.
Able to travel internationally without restriction
Experience localizing a global service or designing products for international markets.
Understanding of users in Asian markets (Japan, India, etc.) or experience with localization projects.
Product design experience improving user acquisition and retention in close partnership with Growth or Marketing.
A portfolio of launching and scaling products for a large user base across multiple markets.
Experience designing core user journeys such as onboarding, profile, and Trust & Safety.
Experience with research and iteration using quantitative data, surveys, and usability testing.
Experience leveraging AI tools and the broader AI ecosystem to design and work more innovatively and productively.
Professional working proficiency in English (Seoul-based, global cross-timezone role).

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:af478895-db0.title: Product Manager - HER
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:af478895-db0.description: Know where you belong! Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire. When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week. HER is the world’s largest community for lesbian, bisexual, and queer people. We’re a global, subscription-based consumer product serving millions of LGBTQIA+ users across 55+ countries — helping people connect, date, and build community in ways that feel authentic, affirming, and fun. HER is part of Match Group, the global leader in dating products, and sits within Match Group’s Everyone & Everywhere (E&E) portfolio alongside other identity-led platforms. This gives us the best of both worlds: the scale, insight, and infrastructure of a global organization, with the autonomy, speed, and cultural focus of a small, mission-driven team. We're hiring a Product Manager I to own product execution at HER on a 9-month temporary basis. You'll run the day-to-day product/engineering sprint cadence — standups, planning, backlog grooming, unblocking — while also shaping what's on the roadmap: pitching ideas and weighing in on feature and design discussions. This is not a pure execution role. On a small, senior team, you'll have real ownership and a direct line to the people building HER's brand and product vision.
responsibilities: Sprint & Execution Ownership
Run the product/engineering sprint cadence — standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retros
Keep releases on track and unblock engineering as issues arise
Translate roadmap priorities into clear, well-scoped tickets and specs

Partner closely with Design, Data/Analytics, Engineering, and CRM to ship high-quality experiences
Coordinate periodically (roughly every other week) with the broader Emerging & Evergreen product team
Build relationships with HER's Head of Product and founder to stay aligned with brand vision
Data-Informed Decision-Making
Use product analytics to inform prioritization and measure the impact of shipped work
Design and interpret experiments in partnership with Data/Analytics
qualifications: Experience with consumer dating/social apps
Familiarity with Figma, Jira, Google Docs, and Notion (or willingness to ramp quickly)
Exposure to subscription revenue models

As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), Advanced Institute of Urology (AUI) is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven physician-led urology network. This partnership empowers Advanced Institute of Urology (AUI) to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our physicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Practice Opportunities: Employed Position with Partnership Track Local Autonomy with National Resources Generous Financial Package Relocation Allowance, Signing Bonus & Annual CME Why Ocala is the Place to Be: Known as the "Horse Capital of the World," Ocala is a vibrant North Central Florida gem that perfectly blends a prestigious equestrian legacy with a high-energy center for outdoor adventure and manufacturing. It is a place where you can watch world-class athletes compete at the World Equestrian Center in the morning and dive into the crystal-clear waters of a natural spring by the afternoon. With a metro population of approximately 400,000, Ocala is large enough to host international sporting events and major distribution hubs, yet small enough to maintain a scenic, rolling-hill, and community-focused atmosphere. Ocala Lifestyle: Natural & Equestrian Beauty: Often celebrated for its sprawling horse farms and ancient oak hammocks, the city is home to legendary natural wonders like Silver Springs State Park and the expansive Ocala National Forest. Cultural Roots: As a focal point for Florida’s inland history, the city hosts the annual Ocala Christmas Parade and features a charming Historic Downtown Square filled with local boutiques, theaters, and Victorian-era architecture. Strategic Growth: As a central logistics hub, Ocala offers the economic resilience of a booming industrial sector paired with the refined lifestyle of a premier retirement and athletic destination. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:bd62b741-47c.title: Project Lion - Senior Prompt Engineer - France (Remote, Part-Time)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:bd62b741-47c.description: We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance.
responsibilities: Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters.
Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus.

Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts.
Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked.
Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall.
Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final.
qualifications: Language Skills : Native fluency in French and fluent in English.
Location:   Must be based in France.
Education : Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field.

Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise : At least 4 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning.
Data Analysis : Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools.
Technical Agility : Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision.
Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API.
Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering.
Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows.
Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic.
